description: Apply a guarded edit and return revisions and diagnostics. replace_literal matches old text (expected_count defaults to 1); create_file refuses existing paths unless replace plus revision_id. delete_file needs revision_id or expected_sha256. Handles support replace_range. operations runs sequentially; a refusal keeps earlier edits. Use change_plan for atomic edits. Transfers preserve bytes; stage Git changes separately. response_mode=compact returns a concise receipt and optional diagnostics; evidence and refusal recovery remain available.

format.description: Format edits (default true); false preserves bytes. Transfers and deletes are never formatted.

idempotency_key.description: Stable retry key; generated if omitted.

include_diagnostics.description: In compact mode include diagnostic bodies/notices; otherwise return their availability and verification status, with diagnostics as the follow-up.

content.description: create_file: the file content; replace_range: exact replacement bytes.

expected_count.description: Required match count (default 1); mismatch changes nothing.

expected_sha256.description: Delete guard (alternative to revision_id); optional copy source guard.

old.description: Exact old text; uniform indentation differences are reported.

replace.description: Overwrite only with its current revision_id.

revision_id.description: Read revision; required for overwrite or delete (unless hash).

operations.description: Sequential edits, excluding replace_range; earlier edits remain on refusal. One formatter pass and receipt.
